subject.title: fix(nostr): strip internal tool-trace banners from outbound text

question: Is the production-hook output plus gateway callback harness sufficient for this pre-relay transformation, or must the contributor provide a real Nostr relay capture?
rationale: Code correctness is well supported, but the external-PR real-behavior gate is unmet and only a maintainer can authorize an override.

options.title: Require relay capture
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted live or equivalent non-mocked Nostr delivery shows a sanitized mixed reply and no trace-only event.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: Accept the existing direct production-hook output and callback harness as sufficient for this pre-network transformation.

recommendation.title: Require relay capture
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted live or equivalent non-mocked Nostr delivery shows a sanitized mixed reply and no trace-only event.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history places this person on the central gateway path, and the contributor directly requested their proof-gate judgment.
